# P2.5 executable configuration boundaries and immutable v0.2 fixture

2026-10-06

## Status

accepted

## Question

P2.5 executable configuration boundaries and immutable v0.2 fixture

## Decision

Replace retired-helper raw PHP text matching with an executable-dependency AST check using public nikic/php-parser APIs. Parse all six affected packages src/tests/config/database/routes, including classless tests and unused imports; detect retired names independent of class availability and literal class strings in documented class-consuming contexts. Keep current documentation text hygiene and native/direct source config-access checks. Historical vaulter-0.2.php is immutable historical evidence: verify independently pinned SHA-256 before execution. Comments in PHP are not executable dependencies. Preserve the exact fixture bytes/path. Direct parser dependency is declared for root and core test installations. Computed dynamic class names are outside this bounded static guarantee; no claim of arbitrary dynamic PHP proof. Required final suite, V28, PG matrix and both original negative controls remain unchanged; add alias/group/class-string/classless/comment/fixture-integrity negative controls.

## Rationale

Exact historical fixture contains four retired-helper references in comments. Original raw match and byte-exact fixture requirements cannot both pass. Native Pest Arch filters names through class_exists and misses deleted-class references; token-only scans do not reliably resolve namespace/import aliases. AST plus independent artifact-integrity validation preserves historical evidence and strengthens executable dependency enforcement, without a fixture-specific code exemption or hidden scope change. Owner selected «AST + SHA-256 (рекомендую): структурная проверка кода без исключения для фикстуры» and requested a considered architecture.
